source_text: Unlike Abrahamic traditions, Hindu rituals emphasize bodily integrity and purity through practices like shuddhi (purification) without surgical alteration of genitalia, viewing the natural form as divinely ordained and interference as potentially disruptive to prana (vital energy) flow. [53]
